title: names
summary: MSUI implements ask-once player, creature, and pet naming. Player responses strictly decode name, realm, and the race/gender/class u32 tail; cache both positive and negative answers plus the positive player traits for the authenticated session; and supply those traits to quest/chat macro expansion when the player object is not streamed. Pets decode their GUID-carried number, request and cache the per-pet display name by that number, clear unanswered asks on zoning, and publish the result across visible world-unit surfaces.

openItems.text: The pet naming path is absent: CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY / SMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE are not implemented, so a summoned pet (guid carrying a pet number, not a template entry) can never resolve a name
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: the exact pet query/response pair, pet-number cache, pending-query lifecycle, and visible name consumers are implemented and clinically pinned.

openItems.text: SMSG_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE's race/class/gender triple is discarded (only the name is kept), so the $R/$C/$G macro fallback for un-streamed players has no data source
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: PlayerNamePackets strictly decodes the 1.12 guid/name/realm/race/gender/class layout; the session-scoped trait cache now supplies $R/$C/$G for unstreamed player subjects in quest and chat macro expansion, with golden packet and runtime-wiring checks.
